input: Set a hard stop time for work each evening

gold.taskTitle: Set a firm daily hard stop time for work
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to establish a consistent, non-negotiable time each evening to stop working.

questions.title: What specific time do you want to stop working?
questions.description: Identify the exact target hard stop time the user has in mind.

questions.title: Do you work from home or a separate workplace?
questions.description: Understand the physical work context to tailor boundary strategies.

questions.title: Which days of the week does this hard stop apply to?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is weekdays only, every day, or a custom schedule.

questions.title: What keeps pulling you past your intended stop time?
questions.description: Identify the specific triggers or habits that currently prevent stopping on time.

questions.title: What reminder or enforcement method appeals to you?
questions.description: Determine whether the user prefers alarms, app blockers, calendar events, or accountability partners.

questions.title: Is there a specific activity that signals the end of your workday?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a shutdown ritual, such as a walk, meal, or hobby, to reinforce the boundary.

questions.title: Who else in your household is affected by your work hours?
questions.description: Understand whether family, a partner, or roommates are involved and can provide social accountability.
